title: Mori, Kenji, the guard and Hamada as 3D models in the game
caption: The staff made the way Kuro, Aoi and Emi were (Reviews mori-meshy-1, kenji-meshy-1, guard-meshy-1, kuroda-meshy-1) now replace their code-built bodies on day 1 and day 2. Kenji is round 2, rounder and chubbier. Rei's model is not in the game: Meshy's auto-rig twisted her skeleton (Review rei-meshy-1), so the code-built Rei stays, hidden all day as before. Stills from the day in test mode.
